    About WPP Production

    We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

    About WPP

    WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

    A Hybrid working model

    We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

    What does a Global Hub Operations Director do at WPP Production? 

    Lead the operational performance and development of Studio A's global production hub network. The role sets a consistent operating standard across locations, turns demand into credible capacity plans, and ensures hubs can deliver secure, high quality work at the service levels and economics agreed with the client. It connects Hub Operations Leads, delivery and capability leaders, Geo teams, Commercial, Talent, HR, Finance, Technology and Facilities so that decisions on capacity, location, cost and risk are made with one view of the facts.

    The Director leads through the Hub Operations Leads and the global operating cadence. They own the hub operating model and its execution, while partnering with the relevant functional and commercial owners on decisions outside hub operations.

    Reporting lines and key stakeholders: 

    • Reports to the Global Operations Director. Manages and develops the Hub Operations Leads across the global network, with clear local accountabilities and escalation routes.
    • Covers centralised production hubs and the resources, infrastructure, controls and services required to support Worldwide and Geo demand, including permanent and flexible capacity.
    • Works in a matrix with Heads of Delivery, capability SMEs, Geo and client operations, Commercial, Talent, HR, Finance, Security, Technology and Facilities. Local employment, technical craft and client commercial approval remain with their designated owners.

    Key Responsibilities:

    Global hub strategy and governance

    • Set the hub operating model, decision rights and governance for shared capacity, including how Worldwide and Geo demand is prioritised, allocated and escalated when requirements conflict.
    • Maintain a practical Hub Playbook covering planning, onboarding, access and security, local compliance, service management, financial controls, business continuity and location specific requirements. Audit adoption and close gaps.
    • Assess the hub footprint against demand, capability, resilience, cost, security and talent availability. Develop business cases and transition plans for expansion, consolidation or changes in the mix of work across locations.
    • Run a regular hub leadership cadence, with consistent status reporting, decisions, actions and cross hub learning. Chair operational reviews and escalate material trade offs promptly.

    Capacity, workforce and delivery

    • Ability to work responsibly on customer sites and take ownership of service activity within your level of competence.

    About Allica Bank

    Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

    Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

    Department Description

    Allica Bank has won multiple recent Commercial Mortgage awards with the CM products being the main driver of lending in the Allica suite, the Commercial Mortgage products have now been well established for over 2 years and continue to grow at pace as a market leader. As part of the risk function within Commercial Mortgages, this role is critical to ensure we can deliver on our objectives in a safe manner.

    Role Description

    The purpose of the role is to underwrite borrowing requests received via a variety of channels, including online in line with the Bank’s approved Credit Policy and in accordance with the Banks asset portfolio (including but not limited to commercial mortgages, commercial investment loans, commercial loans against leasehold properties) .

    Principle Accountabilities

    • Assess and underwrite direct credit loan applications within personal discretion, in line with the all regulatory requirements, the Bank’s credit appetite policy and underwriting policies utilising appropriate credit data and analytical tools.

    • Produce clear, accurate and concise written documentation, making clear recommendations to the Credit team for loan application requests falling outside of personal discretion or outside of credit policy, escalating cases where necessary to the appropriate Delegated Lending Authorities.

    • Manage and own the end to end application process, from initial enquiry to completion, liaising effectively with the panel solicitors in terms of required security instructions and ensure loans are appropriately documented and borrowing is fully secured before draw-down.

    • Liaise with the Credit team as required in managing the credit risk environment, concentration risk and developing credit policy.

    • Undertake regular checks and monitor agreed controls to ensure the Bank’s risk and customer requirements are met at all times; escalating immediately any areas of concern

    • Manage a portfolio of advances to a defined arrears and collections policy.

    • Liaise effectively with applicants (or their brokers) and valuers in requests for additional relevant information to support the credit decisioning process.

    • Deliver an excellent service is given to customers, their brokers and Relationship Managers, building and maintaining strong relationships in line with the Bank’s values and defined customer experience standards.

    • Ensure compliance with all mandatory policies and adherence to credit procedures to maintain internal credit controls.

    • Fully understand and comply with operational procedures, requirements and SLA’s.

    • Help develop appropriate MI and KPI indicators and reporting, maintaining suitable MI to enable a detailed understanding of Mortgage processing pipeline

    • Actively search for areas of improvement for the Bank and your team and take ownership for delivery of these, setting a good example by displaying appropriate values and behaviour

    Personal Attributes & Experience

    • Exposure/knowledge of underwriting, with experience in the SME sector, with an understanding of the competitor landscape and the dynamics and trends of the SME market.

    • Excellent credit/financial analysis skills including the analysis of financial accounts, budgets and cashflow forecasting, Understanding of the loan underwriting process and the risks involved and be able to assess applications within a personal discretion and make recommendations and take commercial decisions.

    • Experience of escalating and presenting at Credit Committee level and Arrears Management.

    • Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills.

    • Ability to build strong and lasting relationships with internal stakeholders such as the distribution team, operations team and senior management, plus 3rd party suppliers such as Intermediaries, Valuers and Solicitors.

    • Understand and comply with all regulatory requirements, plus internal policies / procedures, guidelines, risks and controls and service levels.

    • Good understanding of TCF, AML, KYC and Conduct risk.

    Working at Allica Bank

    At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

    Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

    • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

    • Options for flexible working

    • Regular social activities

    • Pension contributions

    • Discretionary bonus scheme

    • Private health cover

    • Life assurance

    • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

    Don’t tick every box?

    Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

    Flexible working

    We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

    Diversity

    We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

    9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

    Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

    Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

    We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

    The Role

    9fin's buy-side clients are the capital behind the credit markets. Credit funds, CLO managers, private credit platforms, and distressed investors run research, underwriting, portfolio monitoring, and relative value workflows that are deep and specialised. They are actively excited about what AI can unlock. Our job is to make that potential real inside their investment teams.

    The Forward Deployed Investor is the person who does it. You are a domain expert who has done the work yourself, and you can credibly sit across the table from a portfolio manager, a private credit underwriter, or a distressed analyst and say: "Here is how this changes the way you invest."

    You will work with 9fin's most strategic buy-side clients, drive deep adoption of our existing AI capabilities across the investment process, and become a critical voice in shaping what we build next. Every client engagement is a source of product intelligence. The insights you bring back from the front line will directly influence 9fin's AI product roadmap and sharpen how we win the next generation of buy-side accounts.

     

    What You Will Do

    • Map investment workflows and find the highest-value insertion points. Embed with client teams to document how sourcing, screening, underwriting, credit committee preparation, portfolio monitoring, and relative value work actually gets done end-to-end. Identify the three to five places where 9fin's AI can materially change the workflow. Co-author adoption success criteria with the client, tied to their investment outcomes.

    • Build 9fin's AI into those workflows. Take the identified insertion points and build them out using 9fin's toolkit: in-platform capabilities, MCP integrations, agents, and future capabilities as they ship. Weighted by workflow depth, not count. Iterate based on real usage behaviour, not intended usage.

    • Drive adoption at your served accounts. Onboard named users across investment, research, and risk. Run enablement sessions with power users, identify and support champions inside the client. Monitor active usage and address dormant seats before they become churn signals. Review adoption monthly with client champions and quarterly with the CIO, head of research, or equivalent sponsor.

    • Feed the field back into 9fin. Every deployment produces structured intelligence, fed to two consumers. First, product and engineering: prioritised requests tied to specific account and workflow context, patterns extracted across deployments. Second, the wider GTM cycle: case studies, demo assets, workflow evidence, and competitive intelligence that sharpen the next GTM cycle.

    • Spot expansion. Identify opportunities inside served accounts for new users, new use cases, new departments, or new products. Document with context and hand to Account Management for commercial follow-up.

    • Private credit and direct lending. Origination, underwriting, documentation review, or portfolio monitoring at a private credit or direct lending platform

    • CLO investing. CLO management, warehouse and portfolio construction, or CLO debt and equity tranche investing

    Member of Technical Staff — Full-Stack

    Remanence is pioneering the next era of enterprise AI by building intelligent systems that learn continuously from real-world execution. We transform complex enterprise workflows and business context into dynamic, interactive environments where AI agents can safely learn, adapt, and improve. By combining high-fidelity simulation environments with state-of-the-art training loops, we build specialized models that solve long-horizon, complex tasks with unmatched reliability. We're building the most talent-dense AI team in Europe to make this happen.

    You’ll build the product through which researchers and customers use Remanence: the web application, APIs, SDKs, and backend services connecting agent activity to evaluation and training. Your goal is to turn complex research capabilities into an intuitive platform that customers can use independently.

    What you'll work on

    • Build interfaces for exploring agent traces, creating environments and verifiers, launching training runs, and comparing evaluations.

    • Develop APIs and SDKs that connect customers’ existing agents, tools, and data to Remanence.

    • Build backend workflows for sandboxed agent sessions, evaluations, and training jobs, with live progress, cancellation, retries, and clear failure handling.

    • Implement platform foundations including authentication, permissions, customer isolation, and audit trails.

    • Own features from prototype to production, working directly with researchers and customers to turn deployment feedback into reusable product capabilities.

    • Own your services in production: testing, observability, performance and on-call.

    Relevant technologies

    • Backend: Python, Rust, FastAPI or Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, REST and gRPC.

    • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, and interfaces for streaming events and data visualization.

    • Platform: Docker, Kubernetes, Ray, and durable workflow orchestration such as Temporal.

    • Bonus: Rust, Python/TypeScript SDK development, or experience building tools for agents and ML workflows.

    • Strong production experience building backend systems in Python is mandatory.

    About you

    You're a strong backend engineer who is comfortable shipping a clean, useful interface. You care about API design, data modeling and correctness under concurrency and failure. You enjoy working closely with researchers and customers, and turning rough needs into tools people rely on.

    We welcome both experienced specialists and generalists who learn exceptionally quickly. Experience deploying agents in production is nice to have. But prior ML experience is not required; evidence of shipping and owning production software matters.

    What we offer

    • Competitive compensation and equity.

    • A fast-paced environment combining frontier research with impactful real-world applications.

    • Visa sponsorship and relocation support for candidates joining us.

    • A flexible hybrid setup, with a preference for working together in person.

    Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !

    Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser.     🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

    🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

    Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN (Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne, avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin.

    Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis, reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur (https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur), en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set. Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT.

    Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet.

    Des compétences en C++/Python, calcul haute performance, PETSc, méthodes Level-Set ou traitement d’images 3D seront appréciées.

    About Mistral

    Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute.     The mission

    You will be the reference point for the most complex hardware interventions across our sites.

    Mistral's compute is our largest investment and the foundation of frontier AI in Europe. As a Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer (L4-L5), you own the interventions that require the highest level of technical expertise: multi-node failures in production, full-rack deployments of GPU-dense systems, and vendor escalations where you speak as the technical authority for our sites.

    You'll work end-to-end — compute, storage, interconnect, power and cooling interfaces — across our data center footprint, raising the bar on reliability as our capacity grows. This is a hands-on senior IC role: deep technical leadership and mentorship, no direct line management.

    Location: Based at one of our data centers in the Paris region, with occasional visits to our other sites as needed.

     

    What you'll do

    • Lead complex interventions — vendor-level and multi-node operations in production: full rack builds and bring-up, GPU-dense platform deployment (H100/H200-class and next-gen, including liquid-cooled racks), intricate recabling, post-restart diagnosis. You own the plan, the risk assessment, and the rollback.

    • Own vendor management — coordinate repairs, part replacements and escalations directly with hardware vendors; hold them to their SLAs; drive proactive fixes from failure trends.

    • Diagnose at depth — correlate symptoms across compute, storage, interconnect and cooling; read BMC/IPMI consoles, OS logs and crash dumps; methodical root-cause analysis that ends in concrete corrective actions.

    • Deploy and validate — structured bring-up and validation of new racks and platforms; work with networking and infrastructure teams to take installations from delivery to production-ready.

    • Lift the team — mentor and pair with L1–L3 engineers on live operations; turn your knowledge into SOPs, checklists and training material; propose and build small automation (Python/Bash) to shorten MTTR.

    • Work the facility interface — partner with critical facilities/engineering ops on power, cooling (air and liquid), PDU and monitoring (BMS/EPMS) boundaries; enforce ESD/LOTO/PPE and audit-ready change discipline everywhere.

    • Own spares & reliability — plan spares strategy, track fleet failure trends, and run proactive vendor actions before incidents happen.

     

    About you

    • 6+ years in data center / server hardware or L2/L3 hardware support, including complex hands-on work in production environments (HPC/AI/cloud at scale strongly preferred).

    • End-to-end hardware expertise: CPU/memory/PCIe (incl. accelerators), NICs, PSUs, drives, network, power and cooling interfaces (DLC included); strong judgment on when and how to escalate.

    • Diagnostics depth: confident with BMC/IPMI logs, Linux logs and CLI checks; structured root-cause analysis.

    Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are a fast-growing team driving massive impact in one of the largest and most under-served industries in the world.

    WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

    As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:

    • Work directly with technical teams at our customers' factories to connect their data and workflows to our software.

    • Apply state of the art AI in challenging real world settings to drive user adoption and prove value to the customer.

    • Collaborate closely with our Deployment Strategists and other Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver value quickly and consistently.

    • Contribute features directly to the product so your customers get the most out of our platform.

    • Proactively keep the product org informed of key pain points and opportunities to make our platform better.

    • A degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related field.

    • 2+ years of experience solving difficult real world problems with state of the art techniques from software development and data science.

    • Fluency in Python.

    • German at C1 level or above.

    • A consistent track record of outsized impact and going the extra mile.

    • An urge to join a fast-paced, impact-driven team.

    Bonus:

    • Familiarity with SQL and AI/ML libraries.

    • Familiarity with DevOps and deployment, in the cloud and on premises.

    • Experience in customer-facing roles, especially with enterprise customers.

    • Experience in manufacturing or a related industry.

    • Prior startup experience.

    We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here at least three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person.

    Feedback loops are short. Access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here grow fast and take on real responsibility.

    Additionally, we offer:

    • Performance-based career & growth paths

    • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

    • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

    • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

    • Flexible parental leave

    • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

    If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

Responsibilities<\/strong>

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome\u2019s core business operations for our next phase of growth.<\/span>

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.<\/span>

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform\u2019s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.<\/span>

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.<\/span>

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.<\/span><\/li>
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.<\/span><\/li>
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.<\/span><\/li>
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.<\/span><\/li>
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.<\/span><\/li>
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.<\/span><\/li>
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.<\/span><\/li><\/ul><\/p>
    Skills<\/strong>

    • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).<\/span><\/li>
    • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.<\/span><\/li>
    • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.<\/span><\/li>
    • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.<\/span><\/li>
    • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.<\/span><\/li>
    • Business fluency in both\u00a0<\/span>English and German<\/span>\u00a0is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff.\u00a0<\/span><\/li><\/ul><\/p>
      What we offer<\/strong>

      Hybrid Work \/\/ Stay flexible:\u00a0<\/span>We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.<\/span>

      Room to grow \/\/ Stay curious:<\/span>\u00a0In regular\/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.<\/span>

      Mental & physical health \/\/ Stay healthy & active:<\/span>\u00a0We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner \"F\u00fcrstenberg Institute\" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.<\/span>

      Taking responsibility \/\/ We #care:<\/span>\u00a0We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.<\/span>

      Teamspirit \/\/ Stay connected:\u00a0<\/span>What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.<\/span>

      Transparency \/\/ We want to be transparent, also when it comes to salary:<\/span>\u00a0If you have any questions about a possible salary range for this position, feel free to send us an email at ----- We will get back to you as soon as possible.<\/span><\/p>

      Darauf kannst du dich freuen<\/strong>

      \u26f1\ufe0f 30 Tage Urlaub \u00a0\u231b Flexible Arbeitszeiten<\/span>\u2728 Regelm\u00e4\u00dfiges Arbeiten aus dem HO<\/span>\u2708\ufe0f Bis zu 4 Wochen im Jahr Work & Travel \u00a0\u2b50 Events<\/span>\u2714\ufe0f 20% Zuschuss zu bAV oder BU \u00a0\u2714\ufe0f Jobrad \u00a0\u2714\ufe0f Hansefit \u2714\ufe0f G\u00fcnstiges Deutschlandticket<\/span>\u2764\ufe0f Wertsch\u00e4tzendes Miteinander \u00a0\u2b50 Vielfalt & Offenheit<\/span><\/p>
      Vorabinformationen<\/strong>

      W\u00e4hrend des 12-monatigen Traineeprogramms bekommst du die Chance dich stetig neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, dein pers\u00f6nliches Netzwerk auszubauen und relevante Bereiche eines eCommerce-Unternehmens kennenzulernen (z.B. Produktmanagement, (Produkt-)Marketing, Vertrieb, HR, Logistik, Einzelhandel, etc.). Der Schwerpunkt deines Traineeships ist das Produktmanagement.<\/span><\/strong><\/span>

      Deine Rotation in andere Fachbereiche passen wir genau auf deine Erfahrungswerte und F\u00e4higkeiten an.

      Nutze die Chance und entwickle dich zum fachlichen Experten oder optimiere im Anschluss an das Traineeship unsere Abl\u00e4ufe im Unternehmen.<\/span><\/p>
      Das ist deine Rolle in unserem Team<\/strong>

      #Einkauf<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong>
      <\/span>Du unterst\u00fctzt bei der Abwicklung und Koordination von Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsaktivit\u00e4ten.\u00a0
      <\/span>#Marktanalyse<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Zahlen sind dein Ding! Du wirst lernen Kalkulationen oder Reports zu erstellen und die Konkurrenz sowie Preisentwicklungen stets im Auge zu behalten.
      <\/span>#Produktmanagement:<\/strong><\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Nach dem Traineeprogramm sollst du deinen ersten kleinen Bereich \u00fcbernehmen, dabei wirst du zum Ansprechpartner\u00a0f\u00fcr Kollegen aus anderen Fachabteilungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmarketing bei der Steuerung von Produktkampagnen zusammen.<\/span>
      #Perspektiven<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>
      <\/span>Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche T\u00e4tigkeiten, nutze die Entwicklungsm\u00f6glichkeiten in einem Wachstumsunternehmen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Du bekommst von Tag 1 an einen Mentor an deine Seite gestellt, der dich auf deinem Weg begleitet.
      <\/span>#Team:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per \u201aDu\u2018. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.<\/span>
      <\/span>#Weiterbildung<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.<\/span>
      <\/span>#Steile Lernkurve<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Du \u00fcbernimmst schnell Verantwortung f\u00fcr Teilprojekte oder sogar kleine Hersteller. Wir geben dir die Tools an die Hand, sodass du nach einem Jahr eigenst\u00e4ndig Produkte betreuen kannst. Und dein Einsatz bleibt nicht unbeachtet - wir sind stolz darauf, \u00fcber 90% unserer Trainees in eine Festanstellung zu \u00fcbernehmen.<\/span>
      <\/span>#Arbeitsumfeld<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem B\u00fcro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der B\u00fcroarbeitstage variieren.\u00a0<\/span><\/p>
      Was solltest du mitbringen?<\/strong>

      #Background<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong>
      <\/span>Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufm\u00e4nnische Ausbildung absolviert und m\u00f6chtest nun ins Berufsleben starten. Vielleicht hast du sogar schon praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln k\u00f6nnen?
      <\/span>#Leidenschaft<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Technik l\u00e4sst dein Herz h\u00f6herschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich n\u00e4mlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.\u00a0\u00a0
      <\/span>#Verhandlungsgeschick<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Du bist aufgeschlossen und \u00fcberzeugst deine Gespr\u00e4chspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen F\u00e4higkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gesp\u00fcr f\u00fcr gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.<\/span>
      #Pers\u00f6nlichkeit<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong>
      <\/span>Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilit\u00e4t und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstst\u00e4ndig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer.
      <\/span>#Was noch?<\/strong><\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Excel oder sogar Pivot sind f\u00fcr dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse k\u00f6nntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern \u00fcberzeugen.
      <\/span>
      <\/span>Du findest dich nicht zu 100% in dieser Beschreibung wieder? Kein Problem - \u00fcberzeuge uns, warum du dennoch der\/die Richtige bist ;)<\/strong><\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span><\/p>
      Das w\u00fcnscht sich dein Team:<\/strong>

      \"Teamarbeit steht im Vordergrund, man sollte sich immer auf das Team verlassen k\u00f6nnen.\"<\/p>

      \u2013 Christian<\/p>

      \"Wer sich entwickeln will, der kann das hier bei uns, d.h. aber auch, dass man dies wollen und zeigen muss.\"<\/p>

      \u2013 Robert<\/p>

      \"Mir ist es wichtig, dass man sich mit dem Job und NBB identifiziert und wir alle an einem Strang ziehen.\"<\/p>

      \u2013 Manuela<\/p><\/p>

Job Description :

JOB SUMMARY


***CANDIDATE MUST BE US Citizen (due to contractual/access requirements)***


This job creates data-driven insights which identify actionable opportunities aligned to the Quadruple Aim of Healthcare: lower per capita health care costs, improved outcomes from and quality of care received, and optimal member/patient and provider experiences with care delivery. The incumbent serves as a consultative subject matter and technical expert for internal and external customers, leveraging advanced analytical expertise and experience to aggregate, analyze and understand patterns in varied and complex data; and articulates analytic findings, business implications, and recommendations to realize identified opportunities.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supports the design, development, execution, dissemination and interpretation of clinical and population health analyses, metrics and reports using clinical, member, financial and administrative data to identify, develop and/or monitor actionable opportunities for improving health and healthcare outcomes and clinical quality and costs of care, efficiently and effectively managing projects to successful completion.
  • Establishes strong, collaborative and effective relationships and communication with internal and external clinical, administrative, operational, financial and technical stakeholders to ensure analytics are actionable and aligned with organizational strategic priorities, needs, plans and resources.
  • Serves as a strategic business partner to internal and external stakeholders as demonstrated by providing thought leadership and subject matter expertise.
  • Supports Senior and Lead level analysts with consultative, technical, subject matter and business expertise mentorship to colleagues across the enterprise.
  • Other duties as assigned or requested.

EXPERIENCE

Required

  • 2 years of Leading the design, execution and dissemination of clinical and population health reporting, analyses and studies of progressive scope and complexity
  • 2 years of Coding languages, analytical software, systems, tools and processes using claims, clinical, enrollment and provider data
  • 1 year of Project leadership in a complex, matrixed environment (payer and/or provider preferred)
  • 1 year of Providing analytical consultation to clinical, administrative, operational and financial stakeholders

Preferred

  • Preference will be given to individuals with a strong health care/insurance analytics background
  • R, SQL, or BigQuery/GCP experience strongly preferred
  • Tableau or R-Shiny experience strongly preferred

SKILLS

  • Demonstrated record of data-driven discovery, intense intellectual curiosity, and a passion for working with data to answer important questions about clinical care and population health that drive the Quadruple Aim
  • Strong working knowledge of coding languages, relational databases, quantitative and qualitative analytic methodologies, advanced analytics and statistics
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills with project team members, stakeholders, executives, and external customer, exceptional written and oral presentation skills, proven ability to communicate interpersonally and technically with technical and non-technical, and internal and external audiences, and the ability to lead through influence
  • Healthcare industry expertise and experience, knowledge about the shifting healthcare environment including trends concerning health insurance, healthcare delivery, provider relationships and regulatory issues
  • Sophisticated knowledge of how organizations work and how to get things done through formal and informal channels
  • Exhibition of perseverance through energy, drive and demonstrated success when resistance or setbacks are encountered
  • In-depth understanding of and experience with both clinical and business processes, and the ability to identify opportunities for improvement and develop solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to informally lead matrixed teams of technical, clinical, administrative, financial and operational staff to achieve shared organizational objectives and strategic goals

EDUCATION

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Nursing, Economics, Health Sciences, Informatics, Biostatistics, Statistics, Epidemiology, Pharmacy or related field OR 6 years of relevant work experience in lieu of a Bachelor's Degree

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Medicine, Public Health, Nursing, Economics, Health Sciences, Informatics, Biostatistics, Statistics, Epidemiology, Pharmacy or related field

Scrunch, a Sitecore company, is on a mission to bring brands to an AI-first future—where people increasingly rely on LLMs to discover, understand, and act on information that matters to them.

As AI search and conversational agents replace traditional web search and browsing, Scrunch helps marketing teams rethink how their products and services are discovered and surfaced on AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more—working with AI platforms, not against them. This shift represents the biggest change to marketing since the dawn of the internet.

Today, more than 500 paying brands—including Fortune 500 companies like Lenovo, category-defining brands like Akamai, ADP, Lenovo and breakout startups like Clerk—use the platform.

About the Role

As an Enterprise AE at Scrunch, you’ll lead complex sales cycles addressing one of the most urgent challenges facing CMOs today: how brands show up in an AI-first world. You’ll own deals end to end—from first conversation through close—navigating multi-stakeholder buying groups, longer sales cycles, and 6–7 figure ACVs.

You’ll operate with autonomy and urgency while partnering closely with marketing and product to help build a repeatable enterprise motion in a fast-moving, competitive category.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from sourcing and discovery through deal strategy, negotiation, and close

  • Manage and close inbound leads while also driving outbound prospecting into mid-market and enterprise accounts

  • Run complex, multi-threaded sales processes with senior stakeholders across marketing, brand, product, and executive teams

  • Sell strategic solutions, not features—help CMOs and VPs solve visibility, performance, and discovery challenges in an AI-first world

  • Execute 6–7 figure deals with longer sales cycles (3–6+ months), navigating ambiguity and evolving buyer needs

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting, CRM hygiene, and consistent follow-up

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Sales to refine messaging, shape enterprise use cases, and influence roadmap priorities

  • Act as a category evangelist, educating prospects on a new and rapidly forming problem space around AI discovery

  • Continuously research the market, identifying target accounts, competitive dynamics, and emerging trends to sharpen your approach

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including significant experience as an Enterprise Account Executive

  • Proven success closing complex 6- and 7-figure deals with multi-stakeholder buying groups

  • Strong executive presence, with the ability to build credibility and trust with CMOs, VPs, and senior marketing leaders

  • Customer-centric mindset, with a passion for understanding buyer needs and delivering high-impact solutions

  • Exceptional communication skills, comfortable articulating value clearly via phone, email, Zoom, and in-person meetings

  • Highly organized and goal-driven, with excellent time management, follow-up, and a track record of exceeding quota

  • Tech-savvy, experienced with CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), sales tooling, and modern SaaS/AI products

  • Startup-ready, able to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment without a perfect playbook

  • Deep curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, and how buyers are adapting their strategies

  • Ability and willingness to travel periodically within your territory and to Scrunch offices

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling into brand, SEO, martech, or AI ecosystems

Scrunch is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and identities. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

HR Operations Specialist

Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET)
Contract type: Full-time
Starting Salary: €25K gross per annum subjected to Experience, skills and Location

Not Your Typical Workplace…

Tired of the 9-to-5 grind? Imagine a World without borders, where opportunities are endless. That's the future of work, and what we are building at WorkMotion. Our remote-first team spans across the world, helping companies hire, onboard, and manage talent internationally through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Fast-paced, people-driven, and globally connected — we empower businesses to build teams without borders.

More Than a Role

We don’t just need a HR Operations Specialist — we need someone who is organised, customer-focused, and passionate about delivering an exceptional employee experience. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, navigating HR processes, and ensuring every interaction is accurate, compliant, and delivered with care. You will work with employment matters across multiple European countries, collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders in a truly international environment.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to stay in their lane. You’ll be at the center of it all — supporting employees and clients throughout the employment lifecycle, coordinating with multiple internal teams, and helping ensure our HR operations run smoothly, efficiently, and compliantly across different countries. — ensuring everything you touch is customer-centric, compliant, efficient, impactful and aligned with our wider goals.

You won’t be a solo operator. You’ll collaborate with clients, employees, leadership, legal, payroll, finance, product, and external partners, bringing everything together to ensure consistency, impact, and momentum across the board.


Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity…

  • Support HR Operations across assigned countries, managing onboarding and employee lifecycle activities while serving as a key point of contact for clients and employees on day-to-day HR matters.
  • Ensure compliance with local employment laws and internal processes by following country-specific requirements, identifying potential risks, and escalating complex issues where appropriate.
  • Deliver a high-quality employee and client experience by resolving HR queries, supporting key employment events, and providing timely, accurate, and customer-focused solutions.
  • Execute HR processes efficiently and accurately while contributing to continuous process improvements, standardisation, and operational excellence across multiple countries.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, Finance, Product, and external partners to ensure smooth delivery of HR services and accurate execution of employee lifecycle activities.
  • Support reporting, audits, HR administration, knowledge management, and operational projects that contribute to the success and growth of the business.


What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…

  • 3+ years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Lifecycle Management, HR Advisory, or a similar client-facing HR role.
  • Good working knowledge of employment law and HR practices, with the ability to confidently manage onboarding, employee lifecycle processes, and day-to-day HR operations.
  • Ability to balance customer needs, compliance requirements, and business objectives in a fast-paced international environment.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Fluent in English and German (written and spoken).


Bonus Points If You Bring…

  • Experience working in an Employer of Record (EOR), global mobility, payroll, or international HR environment.
  • Experience supporting multinational clients across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms and process improvement initiatives.
  • Additional European language skills and knowledge in employment law.

Social Content & Growth Strategist
Fully Remote Work From Home Role
Compensation Based on Experience

Role

Our client is a comic and entertainment company looking for a hands on Social Content & Growth Strategist to help build audiences around their characters, stories, digital products, games, and upcoming entertainment projects.

This is not a traditional social media manager role. They need someone who can research what is working, generate original ideas, create content, direct a graphics team, publish, analyze results, and continually evolve the strategy.

You should be equally comfortable coming up with a meme, editing a Reel, researching why an account is suddenly growing, building next week’s content calendar, and looking at analytics to determine what to try next.

They are looking for someone curious, resourceful, organized, creatively ambitious, and deeply familiar with how internet culture and social platforms actually work today.

What You'll Do

Creative & Content

  • Develop original concepts for memes, static posts, carousels, short-form videos, character content, and recurring social series.
  • Turn concepts into finished, publishable content using the company’s existing artwork and assets.
  • Write strong captions, hooks, headlines, and short-form copy in distinct character voices.
  • Edit short-form videos and create social-first graphics.
  • Use AI-assisted creative tools intelligently while ensuring finished content feels intentional, polished, and human rather than generically AI-generated.
  • Identify opportunities to repurpose comics, animation, games, trailers, and other existing assets into social content.

Growth & Research

  • Constantly research emerging social formats, platform changes, algorithm behavior, creators, entertainment brands, fandoms, memes, and cultural trends.
  • Identify what’s driving growth for other accounts and translate those observations into experiments the team can run.
  • Develop strategies for reaching non-followers through shares, recommendations, collaborations, creators, trends, and other organic distribution.
  • Find relevant creators, communities, accounts, and potential collaborators.
  • Proactively bring new growth ideas to the team rather than waiting for assignments.

Publishing & Organization

  • Own and maintain the social content calendar.
  • Schedule and publish consistently across active accounts.
  • Keep assets, drafts, approvals, captions, and publishing schedules organized.
  • Coordinate with designers, animators, editors, and other team members for assets as needed.
  • Help manage multiple distinct social accounts.

Analytics & Experimentation

  • Track reach, non-follower reach, engagement, shares, saves, watch time, profile visits, follower growth, clicks, and other relevant metrics.
  • Identify which content and formats are actually driving discovery and audience growth.
  • Run small experiments, evaluate the results, and quickly iterate.
  • Provide simple, actionable reporting focused on what worked, what didn’t, why, and what should be done next.
  • As the company’s commerce ecosystem grows, help connect social performance to digital product sales, game engagement, email acquisition, and app growth.

What we're looking for

  • Strong understanding of Instagram/Meta and TikTok, particularly short-form content and organic discovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to personally create compelling social content, not simply manage other creators.
  • Strong copywriting instincts and a good sense of humor.
  • Fluency in memes, internet culture, entertainment, fandoms, creators, and emerging social trends.
  • Comfortable with Canva and/or Adobe tools, plus short-form video editing software.
  • Experience using modern AI creative tools is strongly preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several content streams simultaneously.
  • Analytical enough to understand performance data without losing the creative instinct behind great content.
  • Resourceful and comfortable figuring things out independently.
  • Proactive — someone who brings ideas and opportunities to the team rather than needing a detailed assignment for every task.

Most importantly: The client is less interested in years of experience than in evidence that you understand how audiences grow today and can turn that understanding into actual content. Know how to learn.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first few months, the client expects this person to help establish consistent publishing across their accounts, develop recognizable content formats for individual characters, improve non-follower reach and organic discovery, identify repeatable growth opportunities, and create a faster feedback loop between research → idea → content → performance → next experiment.

The larger goal is to turn the company’s social channels into an audience engine that supports its characters, digital products, games, original shows, and ultimately the broader company ecosystem.

Remote

Availability

Part-Time (20h per week)

Must be available to collaborate during U.S. Pacific Time (PT) business hours

Compensation
Based on experience. Please indicate your desired hourly rate when submitting your application.

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge’s in-house legal team is a group of lawyers and legal professionals operating across multiple disciplines. As we continue to expand, we are looking for a practical, versatile product lawyer to join our growing legal team. The right person can identify the legal issue quickly, learn the product deeply, and give the business a practical path forward.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams, embedding legal and compliance frameworks into our product lifecycle. You will own matters independently and help turn recurring questions into clear guidance and durable systems that support innovation while ensuring compliance with healthcare, privacy, and other regulatory requirements. This is a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of both AI and healthcare.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a primary legal partner for our products and features from early design through launch and post-launch review.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, policy, partner experience, marketing, IT, finance, corporate development, and commercial to ensure alignment and mitigate risk.

  • Review product launches, feature changes, user-facing disclosures, and marketing claims

  • Develop and scale practical legal processes, frameworks, and templates that enable teams to move quickly with appropriate guardrails

  • Provide actionable legal guidance on regulatory, privacy, and compliance matters, including the evolving AI/ML landscape.

  • Flex across the broader Product, Privacy and Regulatory Legal portfolio as company priorities and risk change.

  • Coordinate with external counsel to resolve specialist issues and ensure fast delivery of actionable legal guidance and risk analysis.

  • Monitor emerging laws and regulations affecting Abridge’s products and data practices and advise internal stakeholders on their implications.

What You’ll Bring

  • Passion for Abridge’s mission and the energy and drive to support fast-moving product and operational teams

  • 5+ years of legal experience, including 3+ years in product counseling. Prior in-house experience at a technology company is a requirement.

  • Working knowledge of privacy and data protection, consumer protection, and intellectual property issues as they apply to technology products

  • Ability to spot issues across a broad range of legal areas, dig into unfamiliar regulatory questions, and know when to bring in specialist expertise

  • Proven ability to communicate and translate complex regulatory and legal concepts into clear, practical guidance for non-legal counterparts and colleagues.

  • Comfort and confidence with juggling a high volume of projects, tight timelines, and competing priorities.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and exercise business judgement; interest in joining a small team that prioritizes autonomy and trust.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally, particularly with technical teams, designers, and commercial teams, building relationships and earning their confidence.

  • Creativity in solving and navigating novel legal matters; experience in crafting new processes and language to meet the needs of a rapidly-moving enterprise in a novel industry.

Bonus Points If…

  • Expertise in intellectual property, AI, or software and technology transactions (e.g., licensing, open source)

  • Familiarity with recent trends in AI, particularly with large language models and responsible AI principles

  • Prior experience at a growth-stage, AI-native, or healthcare technology company

  • Strong understanding of and experience with federal and state healthcare laws, including HIPAA and state health privacy laws

  • Experience with healthcare regulatory matters, including FDA, FTC, fraud, waste, and abuse laws, health data interoperability and information blocking rules, and related state laws

This role is in San Francisco or New York City. Monday/Wednesday/Friday are in office days.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Key Responsibilities:

As the Child & Community Impact Data Specialist, you will define and drive the strategic evolution of World Vision’s sponsorship impact intelligence ecosystem—shaping how child and community impact is translated into compelling, sponsor-facing engagement experiences globally.

You will lead the design and implementation of integrated impact intelligence frameworks that connect child sponsorship data, programme outcomes, and storytelling into scalable, AI-enabled engagement experiences across 30+ markets.

Working in close partnership with global marketers and internal systems teams, you will support sponsor engagement, acquisition, and retention by ensuring high-quality data, system readiness, and efficient, automated storytelling solutions.

This role plays a critical part in strengthening the sponsorship experience by ensuring it is grounded in credible, connected evidence of change—capturing the story of both the child and their community.

You will lead cross-functional collaboration to design, deliver, and continuously improve impact data frameworks that meet the needs of Support Offices, field teams, and sponsors worldwide, while advancing the transition from static reporting to dynamic, data-driven storytelling.

As part of a global team, you will help enable children and their communities to share their stories, while empowering sponsors to better understand and connect with the impact they help create.

Architect modular data-to-story frameworks and a transition roadmap from legacy processes to AI-enabled impact systems. Translate indicators into narrative building blocks. Enable AI-assisted storytelling pipelines and quality assurance of generated stories.
  • Coordinate Data Delivery
    Oversee the end-to-end process of collecting, validating, and delivering sponsor-ready impact data to ensure consistency, timeliness, and alignment with global standards.
  • Integrate Child & Community Data
    Co-develop a fully integrated approach to combine RC monitoring with programme activity monitoring—delivering a holistic ‘child in community’ impact narrative.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement
    Lead ongoing enhancements to data quality, systems, and delivery processes that promote simplification, performance, and deeper alignment with World Vision’s programming work.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, International Development, or equivalent.

  • Flexible and willing to travel per World Vision policy.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Unix/Linux Compute Subject Matter Expert to provide L3 technical leadership and operational ownership for a global estate of Unix/Linux server instances. The SME will be accountable for infrastructure stability, availability, security and performance, and will own patching, vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management and continuous improvement across the environment. Working within a follow-the-sun model spanning APAC, EMEA and NLAM, the role guides L1/L2 teams and partners closely with Security, Database, Storage, Network, Cloud and Application teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality service.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Provide L3 technical support for P1–P4 incidents and complex OS-level issues.
  • Lead and technically guide L1/L2 Unix/Linux operations teams across global regions.
  • Administer and troubleshoot RHEL, Ubuntu, AIX and Solaris environments.
  • Own OS patching, patch compliance and vulnerability remediation.
  • Perform CIS hardening and security baseline remediation.
  • Manage OS performance and capacity, including filesystem, CPU, memory and I/O issues.
  • Support server build, configuration, lifecycle and decommissioning activities.
  • Drive problem management, root cause analysis (RCA) and permanent corrective actions.
  • Support monitoring, disaster recovery (DR) activities and operational readiness.
  • Develop and maintain operational runbooks, procedures and technical documentation.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Security, Database, Storage/Backup, Network, Cloud and Application teams.
  • Ensure consistent service delivery through the APAC–EMEA–NLAM follow-the-sun operating model.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8–12+ years of experience in enterprise Unix/Linux infrastructure and production operations.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Unix/Linux system administration.
  • Expert knowledge of one or more of: RHEL, Ubuntu, AIX, Solaris.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across OS, filesystem, process, performance and system services.
  • Experience with OS patching, vulnerability remediation and CIS hardening.
  • Strong knowledge of LVM, NFS, SSH, DNS, filesystem management, package management and cron.
  • Experience in enterprise 24x7 production operations.
  • Strong ITIL-based Incident, Problem and Change Management experience.
  • Experience leading and mentoring L1/L2 teams and handling major incidents.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Shell, Python, Ansible or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Red Hat RHCSA / RHCE certification.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring and patch-management tools.
  • ServiceNow or other ITSM platform experience.
  • Knowledge of VMware, AWS/Azure, and Backup/DR solutions.
  • Experience working in a global follow-the-sun support model.

Why Gruve

At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Become a part of our caring community

The Clinical Performance Strategy & Measurement Team shapes how Humana defines, measures, and improves clinical performance across the enterprise. By identifying high-impact opportunities to improve healthcare quality, affordability, provider performance, and member outcomes, the team informs enterprise strategy and drives meaningful change across the healthcare ecosystem. At its core, the team's mission is to ensure Humana measures what matters, enabling targeted actions that help members receive higher-value care, achieve better health outcomes, and support a more affordable healthcare experience.

The Clinical Strategy and Program Development Lead develops and advances enterprise clinical strategies that improve healthcare quality, affordability, provider performance, and member outcomes. As part of the Clinical Performance Strategy & Measurement Team, this role identifies and evaluates high-impact opportunities, assesses performance gaps, and develops clinical performance frameworks and quality measures that enable the organization to define, track, and improve performance across the enterprise.

Partnering across clinical, analytics, operations, network, and business teams, the Clinical Strategy and Program Development Lead translates complex data and insights into business cases, strategic recommendations, and investment priorities that drive measurable clinical and business value. The role operates within a strategy-to-execution model, helping move enterprise priorities from opportunity identification through implementation, measurement, adoption, and sustained impact.

This position plays a key role in shaping Humana's long-term clinical performance strategy by identifying emerging opportunities, developing strategic roadmaps, advancing innovative measurement approaches, and creating scalable solutions that deliver sustainable enterprise value.

Clinical Strategy & Opportunity Development

  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve clinical performance across priority populations and specialties through data analysis, measurement gap assessment, and development of performance frameworks and quality measures.
  • Conduct strategic assessments of clinical performance and measurement gaps to identify improvement opportunities and advance enterprise priorities.
  • Conduct specialty landscape analyses and identify gaps in performance, measurement, and enterprise capabilities to inform future investment decisions.
  • Develop business cases, strategic recommendations, and adoption approaches for new clinical initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain strategic roadmaps that prioritize future clinical performance opportunities and align investments with enterprise objectives.
  • Own and maintain a pipeline of future clinical performance opportunities aligned to enterprise priorities.

Measurement & Performance Improvement

  • Develop clinical performance frameworks, quality measures, and measurement strategies to evaluate outcomes and drive improvement.
  • Partner with clinical, analytics, and business leaders to ensure performance measures align with organizational objectives and support meaningful action.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities, establish success metrics, and evaluate results.
  • Support governance processes related to clinical performance measurement and prioritization.

Strategic Leadership & Collaboration

  • Build strong partnerships across clinical, operational, analytics, network, and business teams.
  • Present recommendations and influence executive decision-making.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve quality, cost, and member outcomes.

Innovation

  • Monitor industry trends and emerging best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to expand enterprise clinical capabilities and deliver long-term value.


Use your skills to make an impact

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 8+ years of experience in healthcare strategy, clinical strategy, healthcare consulting, population health, provider performance, value-based care or quality improvement OR 4 years of experience from a top tier consulting
  • Experience developing strategic recommendations using quantitative and qualitative data analysis
  • Experience leading cross-functional strategic initiatives and driving results across multiple stakeholders
  • Experience partnering with analytics teams to analyze healthcare data and generate actionable insights
  • Experience developing business cases and presenting recommendations to senior leadership
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, and storytelling skills
  • Self-starter with the ability to proactively identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and manage competing priorities
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and drive results in a fast-paced environment
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

Role Desirables


  • Advanced degree (Master's or Doctorate) in Business (MBA), Public Health, Epidemiology, Healthcare Administration, Clinical Informatics, or a related field

  • Knowledge of healthcare claims data, clinical coding systems and taxonomies (e.g., ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), quality measurement methodologies, performance analytics, and their application to performance measurement and improvement initiatives

  • Experience synthesizing evidence from peer-reviewed literature, industry research, and healthcare trends to support strategic decision-making

The Director, Financial Reporting & Internal Controls is responsible for the Company’s consolidated financial reporting, technical accounting, global statutory reporting and audit activities, and oversight of the internal control environment. This role will oversee a small team, providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, workload prioritization and performance support while ensuring high-quality execution of key reporting and control deliverables. The role partners closely with senior finance leadership, regional finance teams, cross-functional stakeholders and external auditors.


Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare the Company’s quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements and related disclosures in accordance with IFRS.
  • Support quarterly and annual reporting processes and review significant accounting entries and adjustments.
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of financial reporting across the organization.
  • Lead the consolidated financial statement audit, acting as the primary relationship manager with external auditors, coordinating key deliverables, reviewing and participating in the negotiation of audit fees, and resolving audit and accounting matters.
  • Serve as a key technical accounting resource and lead the assessment and documentation of complex and non-routine transactions under IFRS, including revenue recognition, share-based compensation, leases, pensions, restructuring and provisions, impairments, business combinations, legal entity restructuring and other complex accounting matters.
  • Monitor new accounting standards and developments and assess their impact on the Company’s financial reporting and accounting policies.
  • Oversee global statutory financial statements, audits and required filings across multiple jurisdictions, including managing the statutory audit calendar, coordinating with local finance teams, external auditors and service providers, monitoring progress and driving timely completion.
  • Oversee the financial internal control environment, including monitoring key controls, identifying control gaps and supporting remediation activities.
  • Partner with Tax, Treasury, Legal and other functions on significant transactions, restructurings and other accounting matters.
  • Support acquisitions, integrations, legal entity restructurings and other strategic initiatives from an accounting and financial reporting perspective.
  • Drive continuous improvement and standardization of financial reporting, statutory audit and related finance processes.
  • Lead, coach and develop a small team, including setting priorities, assigning work, providing timely feedback and supporting professional growth.
  • Promote a collaborative, high-performance team environment with clear expectations, effective communication and accountability for deliverables.
  • Support ad hoc projects and transactions as required.

Requirements

  • Must hold a recognized professional accounting designation (CPA, ACA, or ACCA).
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, preferably including experience in a large multinational organization and/or public accounting.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS.
  • Experience in preparing consolidated financial statements and related disclosures.
  • Strong technical accounting research and documentation skills.
  • Experience managing external audits and global statutory reporting requirements.
  • Experience working across multiple legal entities, jurisdictions and finance teams.
  • Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex accounting matters clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated people management experience, including coaching, developing and managing the performance of direct reports in a finance or accounting environment.
  • Experience with SAP, BlackLine and financial consolidation/reporting systems is an asset.

Vacancy: Replacement

Salary Range: $130,000- $150,000
